contractNote: Monthly fees require a minimum 1-year contract. The setup fee is paid once.

valuePoints.title: Setup fee = expert architecture work
valuePoints.text: The setup fee covers Cyber Security Architect hours: working with your leadership, reviewing your entire IT structure and designing a roadmap tailored 100% to your organization. More requirements and longer timelines mean more expert time.

valuePoints.title: Costs far less than a breach
valuePoints.text: Recovery costs and legal penalties (such as under PDPA) after a cyberattack can reach tens or hundreds of millions of baht. A monthly fee for a team that monitors your posture and keeps your staff's skills current is a sound investment.

valuePoints.title: Backed by contract and SLA
valuePoints.text: Every plan is a contract with a guaranteed response time. On Ultimate Prism, our team responds to an attack within 15–30 minutes, 24 hours a day.
